review_evidence: Inventoried all 1,263 primary Agda files: 1,183 src modules, 51 executable/formal documentation examples, 28 tests and one .github tooling module. The src tree is the standard library formal API and the docs/tests contain concrete typed examples and checks, so they remain searchable.

The documentation and test trees were retained deliberately rather than excluded by role: they exercise the actual library and provide formal usage witnesses across data, algebra, effects, reflection, IO, pretty printing and related modules.
.github/tooling/index.agda was inspected completely; aside from OPTIONS/comments it only declares module index and imports README and Everything as an exhaustive tooling/navigation check.

rules.content_invariant: The selected .github file only sets Agda options, declares module index and imports README/Everything for tooling/navigation; it owns no independent standard-library definition, theorem/proof or formal example, while src/doc/tests remain retained.
evidence: The 1,183 src, 51 doc and 28 test primary files were inventoried and retained as library or formal usage/check material.
rules.rationale: Remove the exact GitHub tooling import-check module from primary formalization search.

summary: Reviewed agda-stdlib; retain its full library plus formal docs/tests, excluding only the exact GitHub tooling import-check module.
